name: IJM Corporation Berhad
overview: 今年 IJM 的业务板块没有出现产能扩张、新业务进入或业务退出的公告；主要业务相关事件是 IJM Properties 以 RM47.5 million 出售位于 Sabah 的 Sandakan 一处物业，以及三家 dormant 子公司进行成员自愿清盘。此外，Sunway Berhad 通过 Maybank Investment Bank 对 IJM 发起有条件自愿全面收购要约，要约价为每股 RM3.15。
overview_en: During the year, there were no announcements of capacity expansion, entry into new businesses, or business exits for IJM's operating segments. The main business-related events were the disposal by IJM Properties of a property in Sandakan, Sabah for RM47.5 million, and the members' voluntary winding-up of three dormant subsidiaries. In addition, Sunway Berhad, through Maybank Investment Bank, launched a conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM at an offer price of RM3.15 per share.

segments.name: 产业发展
segments.note: 今年 IJM Properties 签署协议出售位于 Sabah 的 Sandakan 一处土地及建筑物。
segments.note_en: This year, IJM Properties entered into an agreement to dispose of a piece of land and building in Sandakan, Sabah.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: IJM Properties Sdn Bhd 与 Coupang Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，出售位于 Sabah 的 Sandakan 一幅约 9,518.4 平方米的土地及一栋带夹层的单层建筑物，现金代价 RM47.5 million。
actions.text_en: IJM Properties Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Coupang Sdn Bhd to dispose of a piece of land measuring about 9,518.4 square metres together with a single-storey building with mezzanine floor in Sandakan, Sabah, for a cash consideration…

segments.name: 制造与采石
segments.note: 今年 Malaysian Rock Products Sdn Bhd 旗下三家 dormant 子公司进行成员自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: This year, three dormant subsidiaries under Malaysian Rock Products Sdn Bhd underwent members' voluntary winding-up.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 三家 dormant 子公司 Azam Ekuiti Sdn Bhd、Oriental Empire Sdn Bhd 及 Warga Sepakat Sdn Bhd 根据《2016 年公司法》第 439(1)(b) 条进行成员自愿清盘，三家公司均为 Malaysian Rock Products Sdn Bhd 的全资…
actions.text_en: Three dormant subsidiaries, Azam Ekuiti Sdn Bhd, Oriental Empire Sdn Bhd and Warga Sepakat Sdn Bhd, are being wound up by way of members' voluntary winding-up pursuant to Section 439(1)(b) of the Companies Act 2016;

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年 Sunway Berhad 对 IJM 发起有条件自愿全面收购要约。
segments.note_en: This year, Sunway Berhad launched a conditional voluntary take-over offer for IJM.

actions.title: INDEPENDENT ADVICE CIRCULAR TO HOLDERS OF THE OFFER SHARES IN RELATION TO THE CONDITIONAL VOLUNTARY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY SUNWAY BERHAD ("OFFER
actions.text: Sunway Berhad 通过 Maybank Investment Bank Berhad 对 IJM 全部普通股（不包括库存股）发起有条件自愿收购要约，要约价为每股 RM3.15。
actions.text_en: Sunway Berhad, through Maybank Investment Bank Berhad, launched a conditional voluntary take-over offer to acquire all ordinary shares in IJM (excluding treasury shares) at an offer price of RM3.15 per offer share.
